stories.title: Mahindra's electric three-wheeler arm eyes IPO in 18 months
stories.summary: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility is considering an IPO in 18 months, citing fuel crisis demand and manufacturing expansion. CEO Suman Mishra noted the company would not rush the listing, as the parent group will fund expansion regardless of the timeline. The market will determine the final decision.

stories.title: Big 4 firms expand Indian advisory teams
stories.summary: The surge in Indian M&A and public offerings has led firms like EY and Deloitte to expand their local advisory teams. EY now counts over 300 partners in its India deals business, while Deloitte’s One M&A practice participated in transactions worth up to $35 billion this year.

stories.title: Wholesale wheat prices remain high despite government auctions
stories.summary: Average wholesale wheat prices reached ₹2,903 per quintal despite the government doubling the quantity offered in weekly auctions to 2 lakh tonnes. Traders suggest the government should now identify why these sales are not cooling the market and consider allowing direct participation by private traders.

stories.title: Maruti Suzuki exports surpass 2025 total by October
stories.summary: Maruti Suzuki exported 4,15,729 units between January and October 2026, exceeding its total 2025 output of 3.95 lakh units. The company accounts for over half of India's passenger vehicle exports, maintaining a lead more than double that of its nearest competitor, Hyundai.

stories.title: Air purifier demand shifts beyond winter season
stories.summary: Air purifier manufacturers report that the category is evolving from a seasonal winter purchase to a year-round necessity. Companies in the Delhi-NCR region have implemented work-from-home mandates and health advisories for staff as consumer interest in indoor air quality continues to rise.

stories.title: Bharti Enterprises marks 50 years of operations
stories.summary: Sunil Bharti Mittal is celebrating 50 years since founding his bicycle parts business in Ludhiana. Now presiding over a global telecommunications empire, Mittal is preparing for another transformation as he seeks to evolve Airtel beyond its current mobile and satellite communications focus.

stories.title: FSSAI to mandate logo for dairy products
stories.summary: The FSSAI is introducing a standardised logo for milk and milk products to help consumers identify items at the point of purchase. The regulator recently notified the amendment to its labelling regulations as part of a broader effort to address quality and safety concerns.

stories.title: Air purifier sales surge as pollution persists
stories.summary: Air purifier sales have spiked following Diwali, with manufacturers reporting a shift from panic-driven seasonal buying to year-round adoption. Consumers in Delhi-NCR and beyond are increasingly treating the devices as a necessity rather than a niche product as air quality remains a persistent concern.

stories.title: ITC targets growth for Savlon and Nimyle brands
stories.summary: ITC expects consumer spending on its Savlon and Nimyle brands to exceed ₹2,000 crore in the medium term. Since acquiring Savlon from Johnson & Johnson in 2015, the company has scaled the brand nine-fold, with both hygiene products currently growing at over 20 per cent annually.

stories.title: Digital skills gap threatens MSME competitiveness
stories.summary: Indian MSMEs contribute nearly half of the nation's exports, yet a KPMG report indicates only 10 per cent of the workforce is formally skilled. Experts suggest that adopting AI and digital finance tools is critical for small businesses to improve productivity and reach new global buyers.

stories.title: Eternal reassesses 2030 electric fleet target
stories.summary: Zomato and Blinkit parent Eternal is revising its 2030 goal for a 100 per cent electric delivery fleet. The company cites rapid business expansion and the evolving EV ecosystem as reasons for the change, though it maintains that electrification remains an economic priority.

stories.title: DPIIT and commerce department to issue defence licences
stories.summary: The commerce and industry ministry has confirmed that the DPIIT and the Department of Commerce are the competent authorities for issuing defence industrial licences. The DPIIT handles manufacturers outside Special Economic Zones, while the commerce department manages those within zones and Export Oriented Units.

stories.title: Foreign investors return to Indian equities
stories.summary: Foreign portfolio investors have infused ₹84,291 crore into Indian equities in November, reversing months of net selling. Market experts attribute the sudden appetite for domestic stocks to improving corporate earnings and attractive valuations, helping the Sensex and Nifty 50 extend their recent recovery.

stories.title: Trade Setup For Nov 16: Nifty Likely To Resume Rally Despite Friday's Sell-Off, Key Levels To Watch - NDTV Profit
Nifty logs longest winning streak since June
stories.summary: The Nifty 50 index recorded its third consecutive week of gains, marking its longest winning streak since June. Supported by foreign inflows and corporate earnings, the benchmark index has risen nearly 9.70 per cent over the past month, leaving investors to weigh the potential for further growth.

stories.title: Market sentiment to be driven by inflation and global data
stories.summary: Analysts expect WPI inflation data, crude oil prices, and foreign investor activity to dictate market direction this week. Globally, investors are tracking US retail sales and Nvidia's upcoming earnings to gauge shifts in rate expectations and sentiment toward the technology sector.

stories.title: Smallcaps jump 3.6%, PSU banks surge 7.5% as Sensex, Nifty extend weekly gains, what lies ahead? - Moneycontrol.com
FIIs drive 7 per cent surge in Indian markets
stories.summary: Foreign institutional investors purchased ₹79,302 crore in Indian equities during the first half of November, coinciding with a 7 per cent rise in benchmark indices. While FIIs bought heavily, domestic institutional investors recorded net selling of ₹49,088 crore during the same period.

stories.title: Indian equity markets extend rally for third week
stories.summary: The Indian equity market extended gains for a third consecutive week, supported by foreign institutional investor buying and volatile crude prices. PSU banks led sectoral gains, while the broader market outperformed benchmark indices. Investors remain focused on corporate earnings and retail inflation data as the rally continues.

stories.title: JBM Auto faces resistance at 515
stories.summary: JBM Auto has recovered to 497.50 after hitting a low of 465 earlier this month. The stock faces a strong barrier at 515, which coincides with its 21-day moving average. Analysts expect the downtrend to resume toward 425 unless the stock can clear the 515 resistance level.

stories.title: Nifty 50 and Sensex maintain bullish momentum
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices remained stable throughout the week, avoiding expected corrections. The Nifty Bank index rose sharply for the second consecutive week, hitting its 61,000 target ahead of schedule. Foreign portfolio investors continued their buying streak for the fourth week, suggesting further potential for upside movement.

stories.title: US benchmark indices see relief rally
stories.summary: The Dow Jones, S&P 500 and NASDAQ rose over 2 per cent last week, snapping multi-week losing streaks. Despite the relief, price action remains mixed. Analysts suggest a broad trading range of 51,000 to 54,000 for the Dow Jones, pending a sustained follow-through rise to confirm the trend.

stories.title: Crude oil recovery faces bearish hurdles
stories.summary: Brent crude futures ended the week at 95.80 after hitting a low of 89.16, while domestic crude futures lost 1.4 per cent. Despite the late-week recovery, the outlook remains bearish as both contracts face key resistance levels ahead. The support level at 90 remains valid for now.

stories.title: Nifty bulls eye key resistance levels
stories.summary: The Nifty index has rebounded above its 50-week moving average, with weekly MACD and RSI indicators signaling bullish territory. Immediate resistance is expected at 25,425 and 25,550. Analysts anticipate a stable start to the week, with support levels identified at 24,850 and 24,600.

stories.title: Diamondback Nears $5 Billion Double Eagle Assets Deal, FT Says - Bloomberg.com
Avatar Growth Capital to raise 1,250 crore AI fund
stories.summary: Avatar Growth Capital is launching an AI-focused fund with a 1,250 crore target. The firm aims to tap global investors to build an enterprise intelligence layer for the world. Co-founder Vishal Bakshi stated that while the industry focuses on computing infrastructure, India holds an underappreciated opportunity in intelligence.

stories.title: Hindalco subsidiary Novelis to sell China assets
stories.summary: Novelis Inc has agreed to sell its Chinese aluminum production and trading subsidiaries to Shenzhen Hongzhi Industrial Investment Co for 265 million dollars. The deal includes a potential 10 million dollar earn-out. The entities, which held 376 million dollars in assets, will cease to be company subsidiaries.

stories.title: Adani Energy Solutions completes IntelliSmart acquisition
stories.summary: Adani Energy Solutions has finalized its 3,050 crore acquisition of smart metering firm IntelliSmart Infrastructure. The deal includes full equity ownership and the redemption of debentures previously held by the National Investment and Infrastructure Fund and Energy Efficiency Services. The Competition Commission of India cleared the transaction in October.

stories.title: CCI clears Go Digit General Insurance merger
stories.summary: The Competition Commission of India has approved the amalgamation of Go Digit General Insurance and Go Digit Infoworks Services. While the regulatory hurdle is cleared, the merger still requires final sign-offs from the NCLT, IRDAI and shareholders before the integration can proceed.

stories.title: Advent International to invest 3,150 crore in Yatharth Hospital
stories.summary: Advent International has received regulatory clearance to acquire a 24.87 per cent stake in Yatharth Hospital for 3,150 crore. The investment aims to expand the hospital chain's infrastructure across North India. The deal highlights the growing role of private equity in the domestic healthcare sector.

stories.title: SoftBank sells 1.65 per cent stake in Meesho
stories.summary: SoftBank Group has offloaded 7.64 crore shares of e-commerce firm Meesho for 1,885 crore through a block deal. The sale, executed at an average price of 246.75 per share, reduces the Japanese investor's affiliate holding in the company to 5.19 per cent.

stories.title: Warburg Pincus to acquire stake in Pricol unit
stories.summary: Warburg Pincus has agreed to buy a 38.51 per cent stake in a new unit of Pricol Ltd for 1,633 crore. The deal follows the demerger of Pricol's driver information business. The private equity firm also plans an open offer for an additional 26 per cent stake in the entity.

stories.title: Pricol board approves stake sale to Warburg Pincus
stories.summary: Pricol Limited has approved the sale of its promoters' 38.51 per cent shareholding in Pricol Autotech to Warburg Pincus for 1,663 crore. The transaction follows the planned demerger of the company's driver information and connected vehicle solutions business, which was originally announced in June 2026.

stories.title: Razorpay receives Sebi approval for IPO
stories.summary: Fintech firm Razorpay has received Sebi approval for an IPO expected to raise 5,000 to 6,000 crore. The offering, likely to list in early 2027, could value the company at 5 billion dollars. The firm has not yet disclosed the split between fresh shares and the offer-for-sale.

stories.title: Swiggy signs 241 crore Bengaluru office lease
stories.summary: Swiggy has leased 2.62 lakh square feet of office space in Whitefield, Bengaluru, for a 10-year term. The company will pay approximately 241 crore in total rent, with a monthly rate of 1.79 crore. The agreement includes a security deposit of 10.75 crore and a rental escalation clause.

stories.title: Bodhi Tree Systems to invest 180 million in Adyar Ananda Bhavan
stories.summary: Bodhi Tree Systems will invest 180 million dollars for a majority stake in the South Indian food chain Adyar Ananda Bhavan. The investment is intended to support the restaurant chain's expansion across India and international markets, building on its existing presence in the casual dining and sweets segment.

stories.title: Tribunal rejects tax addition based on WhatsApp chat
stories.summary: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal deleted a tax addition against Khushi Advertising Ideas Private Limited. The department had relied on a WhatsApp conversation and a photograph of a ten rupee note to allege a cash delivery. The tribunal found no evidence linking the company to the transaction.

stories.title: High court protects pension from loan recovery
stories.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh High Court ruled that pension benefits cannot be seized to recover a loan borrowed by another person, even if the retiree acted as a guarantor. The court restrained the bank from deducting funds, citing the pension as a essential welfare measure.

stories.title: Pay commission scenarios for government employees
stories.summary: A central government employee earning 29,200 rupees could see their basic pay exceed 1 lakh rupees in ten years if annual increments rise to 7 percent. The calculation assumes a 2.1 fitment factor. Lower increment rates would result in a lower final salary over the same period.

stories.title: Steps for taxpayers receiving duplicate refunds
stories.summary: Taxpayers who receive a duplicate income tax refund should verify the transaction details through the income tax portal. Refunds are credited to a single nominated bank account, and each grant is assigned a unique UTR number. Users can check the status of filed returns online.

stories.title: Consumer court orders bank to refund fraud victim
stories.summary: A Delhi consumer court ordered a private bank to refund 70,084 rupees to a woman following unauthorised transactions in 2016. The bank must also pay 25,000 rupees in compensation and costs. The ruling notes that the customer did not receive transaction alerts due to technical phone issues.

stories.title: EPFO to host trade fair pavilion in November
stories.summary: The Employees Provident Fund Organisation will operate a pavilion at the India International Trade Fair in New Delhi from 14 to 27 November 2026. The body invites members to visit the stall at Bharat Mandapam to discuss services, social security initiatives and reforms.

stories.title: Credit score risks for loan guarantors
stories.summary: Signing a guarantee agreement makes an individual financially responsible for a loan if the primary borrower defaults. Missed payments or delays by the borrower can damage the guarantor's credit score. A guarantor is not merely a reference but a party liable for the outstanding debt.

stories.title: Kisan Vikas Patra investment details
stories.summary: Kisan Vikas Patra is a government-backed savings scheme offering a 7.5 percent interest rate with a 115-month maturity period. Investors aiming to conserve capital without market volatility may consider the scheme. Potential participants should review deposit limits and withdrawal conditions before committing funds.

stories.title: Common mistakes in senior citizen savings scheme
stories.summary: Retirees planning to invest up to 30 lakh rupees in the Senior Citizens Savings Scheme should be aware of common errors that can reduce potential benefits. The scheme is a government-backed option designed to generate consistent income for those in retirement.

stories.title: Court bars pension deduction for guarantor defaults
stories.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh High Court ruled that banks cannot recover a defaulted loan from a retired employee's pension, even if the retiree served as a guarantor. The court set aside a lower order to protect the income of the retired police personnel.

stories.title: Tribunal rules on bank account deposits
stories.summary: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal deleted a 3.69 crore rupee tax addition against a Firozabad woman. The department had treated money passing through her account as unexplained income. The tribunal held that the department failed to establish the funds actually belonged to the taxpayer.

stories.title: Comparing mutual fund SIPs and post office deposits
stories.summary: Investing 10,000 rupees monthly for five years yields different results depending on the asset class. Mutual fund SIPs offer market-linked potential with higher risk, while Post Office Recurring Deposits provide predictable returns. The final corpus depends entirely on the chosen investment path and planning.
